searchText: hi 👋 there it is oh <@!385978868131168259> a new channel hwllo <:turbo:688089339384561777> ✨ 🏗️ 🧊 not on the execution-layer side but new builder/proposer separation sharding design led by <@!203220829473996800> just landed in the specs for the next wave of sharding prototyping https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/pull/2486 designs inspired by https://ethresear.ch/t/proposer-block-builder-separation-friendly-fee-market-designs/9725 really nice thing in sharding is the shift of the responsibility of data-availability to the well incentivized (and hopfully well connected) builder Also allows for small (wrt data size) data-txs to be sent on global channels not wasting bandwidth before a payload is selected by a proposer (and thus then 0.5 to 1MB payloads being sent)

not on the execution-layer side but new builder/proposer separation sharding design led by <@!203220829473996800> just landed in the specs for the next wave of sharding prototyping

https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/pull/2486

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
really nice thing in sharding is the shift of the responsibility of data-availability to the well incentivized (and hopfully well connected) builder

Also allows for small (wrt data size) data-txs to be sent on global channels not wasting bandwidth before a payload is selected by a proposer (and thus then 0.5 to 1MB payloads being sent)
